40023025.author: पदार्थः
40023025.content: कस्यचित् some, त्वथ then, कालस्य of time, युधाजित् Yudhājit, केकयो Kekaya, नृपः king, स्वगुरुम् his own preceptor, प्रेषयामास sent, राघवाय to Rama, महात्मने to the great-souled one, गार्ग्यम् Gārgya, अङ्गिरसः of Angiras, पुत्रम् son, ब्रह्मर्षिम् a Brahmarshi, अमितप्रभम् of immeasurable splendor.

40023025.author: Translation
40023025.content: Then, after some time, King Yudhājit of Kekaya sent his own preceptor, Gārgya, the son of Angiras, a Brahmarshi of immeasurable splendor, to the great-souled Rama.

40023026.author: पदार्थः
40023026.content: दश ten, च and, अश्वसहस्राणि thousands of horses, प्रीतिदानम् a gift of affection, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40023026.author: Translation
40023026.content: And ten thousand horses, an unsurpassed gift of affection, were also sent.

40023027.author: पदार्थः
40023027.content: कम्बलानि blankets, च and, रत्नानि jewels, चित्रवस्त्रम् colorful garments, अथ then, उत्तमम् excellent, रामाय to Rama, प्रददौ gave, राजा the king, शुभानि auspicious, आभरणानि ornaments, च and.

40023027.author: Translation
40023027.content: The king also gave blankets, jewels, excellent colorful garments, and auspicious ornaments to Rama.

40023028.author: पदार्थः
40023028.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु and, राघवः Rama, धीमान् the intelligent, महर्षिम् the great sage, गार्ग्यम् Gargya, आगतम् who had arrived, मातुलस्य of the maternal uncle, अश्वपतिनः Ashvapati, प्रहितम् sent, तत् that, महाधनम् great wealth.

40023028.author: Translation
40023028.content: The intelligent Rama, having heard that the great sage Gargya, sent by his maternal uncle Ashvapati with great wealth, had arrived.

40023029.author: पदार्थः
40023029.content: प्रत्युद्गम्य having gone forth to meet, च and, काकुत्स्थः Rama, क्रोशमात्रम् for a distance of a krosa, सहानुजः with his younger brothers, गार्ग्यम् Gargya, सम्पूजयामास honored greatly, यथा just as, शक्रः Indra, बृहस्पतिम् Brihaspati.

40023029.author: Translation
40023029.content: And Rama, along with his younger brothers, went forth for a krosa to meet Gargya and honored him greatly, just as Indra honors Brihaspati.

40023030.author: पदार्थः
40023030.content: तथा thus, सम्पूज्य having honored greatly, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, तत् that, धनम् wealth, प्रतिगृह्य having received, च and, पृष्ट्वा having asked, प्रतिपदम् every detail, सर्वम् all, कुशलम् welfare, मातुलस्य of the maternal uncle, च and, उपविष्टम् seated, महाभागम् the highly fortunate one, रामः Rama, प्रष्टुम् to ask, प्रचक्रमे began.

40023030.author: Translation
40023030.content: Having thus greatly honored that sage, received the wealth, and inquired about every detail of his maternal uncle's welfare, Rama then began to question the highly fortunate sage who was now seated.

40023031.author: पदार्थः
40023031.content: किम् what, आह said, मातुलः the maternal uncle, वाक्यम् message, यदर्थम् for which purpose, भगवान् the revered one, इह here, प्राप्तः arrived, वाक्यविदाम् among those skilled in speech, श्रेष्ठः the best, साक्षात् directly, इव as if, बृहस्पतिः Brihaspati.

40023031.author: Translation
40023031.content: Rama asked what message his maternal uncle had sent, for which purpose the revered sage, who is the best among those skilled in speech, had arrived here, as if Brihaspati himself.

40023032.author: पदार्थः
40023032.content: रामस्य Rama's, भाषितम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, महर्षिः the great sage, कार्यविस्तरम् the detailed matter, वक्तुम् to tell, अद्भुतसङ्काशम् wonderful, राघवाय to Rama, उपचक्रमे began.

40023032.author: Translation
40023032.content: Having heard Rama's words, the great sage began to narrate the detailed and wonderful matter to Rama.

40023033.author: पदार्थः
40023033.content: मातुलः maternal uncle, ते your, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, वाक्यम् words, आह said, नरर्षभः O best among men, युधाजित् Yudhājit, प्रीतिसंयुक्तम् filled with affection, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, यदि if, रोचते it pleases.

40023033.author: Translation
40023033.content: Yudhājit, your maternal uncle, O mighty-armed Rama, has spoken words filled with affection, which you should hear if they please you.

40023034.author: पदार्थः
40023034.content: अयम् this, गन्धर्वविषयः region of Gandharvas, फलमूलोपशोभितः adorned with fruits and roots, सिन्धोः of the Sindhu (river), उभयतः on both sides, पार्श्वे on the banks, देशः region, परमशोभनः exceedingly beautiful.

40023034.author: Translation
40023034.content: This region of the Gandharvas, adorned with fruits and roots, lies on both banks of the Sindhu river and is exceedingly beautiful.

40023035.author: पदार्थः
40023035.content: तम् that, च and, रक्षन्ति protect, गन्धर्वाः Gandharvas, सायुधाः armed, युद्धकोविदाः skilled in warfare, शैलूषस्य of Shailūṣa, सुताः sons, वीर O hero, त्रिकोट्यः three crores, वै indeed, महाबलाः very powerful.

40023035.author: Translation
40023035.content: O hero, that region is protected by three crores of very powerful Gandharvas, the sons of Shailūṣa, who are armed and skilled in warfare.

40023036.author: पदार्थः
40023036.content: तान् them, विनिर्जित्य having conquered, काकुत्स्थ O descendant of Kakutstha, गन्धर्वनगरम् city of Gandharvas, शुभम् auspicious, निवेशय establish, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, स्वे your own, पुरे city, सुसमाहिते well-established.

40023036.author: Translation
40023036.content: O mighty-armed Rama, descendant of Kakutstha, having conquered those Gandharvas, establish your own well-governed and auspicious city in that Gandharva region.

40023037.author: पदार्थः
40023037.content: अन्यस्य for anyone else, न not, गतिः access, तत्र there, देशः region, परमशोभनः exceedingly beautiful, रोचताम् let it please, ते you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, न not, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, अहितम् harmful, वदे speak.

40023037.author: Translation
40023037.content: No one else has access to that exceedingly beautiful region; O mighty-armed one, may this proposal please you, for I would never speak anything harmful to you.

40023038.author: पदार्थः
40023038.content: तत् that (proposal), श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Rama, प्रीतः pleased, महर्षेः of the great sage (Valmiki), मातुलस्य of the maternal uncle (Yudhajit), च and, उवाच said, बाढम् certainly, इति एव thus, भरतम् Bharata, च and, अन्ववैक्षत looked at.

40023038.author: Translation
40023038.content: Hearing the proposal from the great sage and his maternal uncle, Rama, pleased, agreed and then looked at Bharata.

40023039.author: पदार्थः
40023039.content: सः he, अब्रवीत् said, राघवः Rama, प्रीतः pleased, स-अञ्जलि-प्रग्रहः with folded hands, द्विजम् to the Brahmin (Valmiki), इमौ these two, कुमारौ princes, तम् that, देशम् region, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi (Valmiki), विचरिष्यतः will go forth/will rule.

40023039.author: Translation
40023039.content: Pleased, Rama, with folded hands, said to the Brahmarshi Valmiki, "O Brahmarshi, these two princes will go forth to that region."

40023040.author: पदार्थः
40023040.content: भरतस्य of Bharata, आत्मजौ sons, वीरौ valiant, तक्षः Taksha, पुष्कलः Pushkala, एव indeed, च and, मातुलेन by the maternal uncle (Yudhajit), सुगुप्तौ well-protected, तु indeed, धर्मेण with righteousness, सुसमाहितौ well-established/well-trained.

40023040.author: Translation
40023040.content: These are Bharata's valiant sons, Taksha and Pushkala, who are well-protected by their maternal uncle and well-trained in righteousness.

40023041.author: पदार्थः
40023041.content: भरतम् Bharata, च and, अग्रतः in front, कृत्वा having placed/making, कुमारौ the two princes, स-बल-अनुगौ accompanied by an army, निहत्य having killed, गन्धर्व-सुतान् the sons of Gandharvas, द्वे two, पुरे cities, विभजिष्यतः will divide.

40023041.author: Translation
40023041.content: With Bharata leading, the two princes, accompanied by an army, will kill the sons of the Gandharvas and then establish two cities.

40023042.author: पदार्थः
40023042.content: निवेश्य having established, ते those, पुरवरे excellent cities, आत्मजौ his sons, सन्निवेश्य having settled, च and, आगमिष्यति will return, मे to me, भूयः again, सकाशम् to the presence, अतिधार्मिकः the very righteous one (Bharata).

40023042.author: Translation
40023042.content: Having established those excellent cities and settled his sons there, the very righteous Bharata will return to my presence again.

40023043.author: पदार्थः
40023043.content: ब्रह्मर्षिम् the Brahmarshi, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken to, तु indeed, भरतम् Bharata, सबलानुगम् with his army and followers, आज्ञापयामास commanded, तदा then, कुमारौ the two princes, च and, अभ्यषेचयत् consecrated.

40023043.author: Translation
40023043.content: Having thus spoken to the Brahmarshi Vashistha, Rama then commanded Bharata, who was accompanied by his army and followers, and consecrated the two princes.

40023044.author: पदार्थः
40023044.content: नक्षत्रेण by the constellation, च and, सौम्येन auspicious, पुरस्कृत्य having placed in front (honoring), अङ्गिरस्सुतम् the son of Angiras (Vashistha), भरतः Bharata, सह with, सैन्येन the army, कुमाराभ्याम् with the two princes, विनिर्ययौ set out.

40023044.author: Translation
40023044.content: Bharata, honoring Vashistha (the son of Angiras) and choosing an auspicious constellation, set out with his army and the two princes.

40023045.author: पदार्थः
40023045.content: सा that, सेना army, शक्रयुक्ता accompanied by Indra, इव as if, नगरान् from the city, निर्ययाव departed, अथ then, राघवानुगता following the Raghava (Bharata), दूरम् far, दुराधर्षा unconquerable, सुरैः by gods, अपि even.

40023045.author: Translation
40023045.content: That army, as if accompanied by Indra, then departed far from the city, following Bharata, and was unconquerable even by the gods.

40023046.author: पदार्थः
40023046.content: मांसादानि flesh-eating, च and, सत्त्वानि beings, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, सुमहान्ति very great, च and, अनुजग्मुः followed, हि indeed, भरतम् Bharata, रुधिरस्य of blood, पिपासया with a thirst.

40023046.author: Translation
40023046.content: Indeed, flesh-eating creatures and very great Rakshasas followed Bharata, driven by a thirst for blood.

40023047.author: पदार्थः
40023047.content: भूतग्रामाः hosts of beings, च and, बहवः many, मांसभक्षाः flesh-eaters, सुदारुणाः very terrible, गन्धर्वपुत्रमांसानि the flesh of the Gandharva princes, भोक्तुकामाः desirous of eating, सहस्रशः by thousands.

40023047.author: Translation
40023047.content: And many thousands of very terrible flesh-eating spirits, desirous of consuming the flesh of the Gandharva princes, also followed.

40023048.author: पदार्थः
40023048.content: सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाणां of lions, tigers, and boars, खेचराणां of sky-dwellers, च and, पक्षिणाम् of birds, बहूनि many, वै indeed, सहस्राणि thousands, सेनायाः of the army, ययुः went, अग्रतः in front.

40023048.author: Translation
40023048.content: Many thousands of lions, tigers, boars, and various birds marched in front of the army.

40023049.author: पदार्थः
40023049.content: अध्यर्धमासमुषिता having stayed for one and a half months, पथि on the path, सेना the army, निरामया healthy, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा filled with joyful and well-nourished people, केकयं to Kekaya, समुपागमत् arrived.

40023049.author: Translation
40023049.content: After staying on the road for one and a half months, the army, healthy and filled with joyful and well-nourished people, arrived in Kekaya. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे शततमः सर्गः ।। 100 ।। Thus ends the hundredth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
